description: Divisional Secretariat of Pelmadulla - Notice under Pilgrimage Ordinance that the Pageant in which the statute of Deity Sri Sumana Saman and the Enclouser Casket with Relics carried to the Sri-pada, 2017-2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns religious/cultural arrangements for a pilgrimage festival (carrying a deity statue and relics to Sri Pada), including logistical instructions, traffic management, and public health measures. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (4-9) as it relates to cultural/religious event administration rather than land, legal, commercial, electoral, public service, or judicial matters.
